title: What Are the Albanian Wedding Traditions You Did Not Know?
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget

refresh_of.note: Person: article to refresh. Check legacy slugs and other ranking pages; recommend direct 301s at publish.

notes: REFRESH: the brief reads the old page in full with mcp__Apify__apify--web-fetch; SEO pulls its ranked keywords and status and checks weddedwonderland.com for legacy slugs and other ranking pages. Keep its traditions if sourceable; never reuse wording; drop errors; correct brand terms; keep the 'partying all week' framing only if a source supports multi-day celebrations.

Scope and naming, no politics: Albanian wedding customs are kept by Albanian communities in Albania, Kosovo, North Macedonia and the diaspora (including Australia). Regional differences (north Gheg, south Tosk) only where sourced. Leave out virginity or 'proof' customs. Do not use the Kanun as a source for wedding practice.

Likely customs (brief finalises): fejesa (engagement), paje or ceizi (trousseau), the henna night, the wedding flag, the groom's party collecting the bride, the bride's arrival and welcome, the bride's traditional dress (xhubleta) where sourced, music and dance (valle), multi-day celebration only if sourced. UNESCO: Albanian folk iso-polyphony (2008) only where UNESCO links it to weddings; any other listing only if its page is confirmed live and the title matches. Albanian spelling with diacritics.

Destination angle: Australians marrying in Albania (Smartraveller current advice, checked live) plus diaspora weddings in Australia. Legal steps from official sources only (Albania's civil status office; the Australian embassy that covers Albania); 'check with the civil status office and the embassy, including any fees' where unreadable; 'a fee applies' only if an official source says so; 'as at November 2026'.

Sources: UNESCO, Albania's Ministry of Culture and official tourism site, national museums, encyclopaedias, academic sources. Unsourced becomes 'often told' or is left out. Customs worded as 'often told' get no [[VERIFY]] marker.
Images: placeholders only; no AI images of people, cultural dress, ceremonies or places; AI only for neutral still lifes labelled illustrative pending approval.

Speed: WebFetch cannot reach outside sites; Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO from the start. Fact-check as 2 parallel batches, 15 min HARD, save after every 3 facts, separate scratch folders; no extra sourcing rounds. Google Drive disconnected; Firecrawl out of credits.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.
Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md (single point of contact; fee and inclusions in writing); no implied help with legal paperwork.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices; no vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
